title: Steven Dick's AI protective layer of Earth idea (Galileo Project)

tellings.quote: I think there's a former NASA guy named Steven Dick who's part of Ovillobe's Galileo project who talks about >> uh this is sort of some sort of AI layer like protective layer of Earth.

plain: Earth may be wrapped in some kind of artificial intelligence that acts as a protective layer, according to an idea Michels credits to a former NASA figure named Steven Dick. Michels says Dick is part of the Galileo Project, an effort led by the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb to look for signs of alien technology. Michels passes this along himself, hedging with "I think", as something he recalls Dick saying.
